household.title: Choose your household and places
household.description:
Select existing Home Assistant people, person trackers, pet trackers and zones. To connect Life360 without another integration, turn on direct connection; its trackers appear after setup and can then be selected in Options.

{tracker_status}

data_description.pets: Choose an existing tracker for each pet. Each selected tracker becomes one pet; no Home Assistant Person record is needed. Check ownership when names repeat.
data_description.people_trackers: Choose a tracker for each person who does not have a Home Assistant Person record. A connected Life360 tracker can be selected here after it appears.
data_description.life360_direct: Optional. HomeCircle will connect to Life360 itself and create device trackers in Home Assistant. Turn this off after replacing any selected HomeCircle-owned Life360 trackers.
data_description.replace_life360_login: Use this if the password or token changed for the same Life360 account. Existing member selections are kept.

member.title: Choose trackers and places

data.configure_sensors: Set up battery and motion sensors

data_description.trackers: Select the suggested tracker, or choose another from the picker. Check the owner and entity ID when names repeat. One tracker is simplest; multiple sources are available for advanced setups. Leave empty to use the HA person alone. Changing this selection does not change the trackers linked to the HA person.
data_description.additional_residences: These zones also count as Home for this member. The Home map button still focuses the primary family home.
data_description.kind: Choose Pet for a pet record. Pet location timing appears on the next screen; this does not create a tracker.
data_description.configure_reports: Choose a genuine location report-time sensor separately for each selected source. Leave off if none is available.
data_description.configure_sensors: Choose optional battery, charging, speed and driving sensors on the next screen.

confirm.title: Review and save household

supporting.title: Status sensors
supporting.description: For {person}, choose only sensors that describe this member. Leave unavailable values empty. Location report times are configured separately for each source.

data_description.battery: Select a sensor with a numeric percentage and % unit.
data_description.charging: Select a binary sensor that says whether this member’s device is charging.
data_description.speed: Select a speed sensor in m/s, km/h or mph.
data_description.driving: Select a binary sensor that reports driving status.
data_description.driving_reported_at: Select the actual time of the driving report. Without it, Driving is shown as last reported or unverified.

source_report.title: Location report time
source_report.description: Source {number} of {total}: {source}. Choose a sensor with the actual time this source reported its location. Leave empty if unknown, or to clear an old mapping for a removed source. Home Assistant state updates are not GPS report times.

pet_freshness.title: Pet location timing
pet_freshness.description: For {person}, choose when a pet location report should be labeled stale. These limits do not change Home/Away status or request a new location.

data.pet_home_minutes: At home: mark location stale after

data_description.pet_home_minutes: Default: 24 hours. Applies at the primary home and this pet’s other homes.
data_description.pet_away_minutes: Default: 5 minutes. Applies when this pet is away from its homes.

pet_member.title: Choose pet places and details
pet_member.description: Member {number} of {total}: {person}. This pet uses its selected tracker directly. Choose any other homes and optional supporting sensors.

data.configure_sensors: Set up battery and motion sensors

data_description.additional_residences: These zones also count as Home for this pet. The Home map button still focuses the primary family home.
data_description.configure_reports: Choose a genuine location report-time sensor for this tracker. Leave off if none is available.
data_description.configure_sensors: Choose optional battery, charging, speed and driving sensors on the next screen.

life360_account.title: Connect Life360
life360_account.description: Enter a Life360 email and password, or an access token. Some accounts with verified phone numbers cannot use password sign-in. Credentials are saved in Home Assistant configuration storage. Home Assistant Recorder may keep a history of the new tracker locations; review its settings before connecting. Member trackers may take several minutes to appear; reopen HomeCircle Options to select them.

data.confirm_same_account: I confirm this is the same Life360 account

data_description.secret: For access token, enter only the token value. HomeCircle uses Bearer authorization.
data_description.confirm_same_account: Only needed if HomeCircle cannot verify the previously saved sign-in for this older setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Life360
reauth_confirm.description: Life360 rejected the saved sign-in. Enter a current password or access token for the same account. HomeCircle will keep your household and tracker selections.

data.confirm_same_account: I confirm this is the same Life360 account

data_description.secret: For access token, enter only the token value.
data_description.confirm_same_account: The old sign-in may have expired, so HomeCircle may need your confirmation that these credentials belong to the same account.

tracker_member.title: Choose person places and details
tracker_member.description: Member {number} of {total}: {person}. This person uses the selected tracker directly. Choose any other homes and optional supporting sensors.

data.configure_sensors: Set up battery and motion sensors

error.invalid_entity: Select an existing, enabled entity of the correct type.
error.primary_in_places: Primary Home is already selected separately.
error.primary_in_residences: Primary Home applies to every member already.
error.entities_changed: A selected entity was removed or disabled. Review your household and member selections again.
error.report_source_required: Select both the location timestamp sensor and the source it describes.
error.invalid_report_source: Select this person or one of their explicitly selected trackers.
error.driving_required: Select a driving binary sensor for this report timestamp.
error.invalid_freshness: Enter a number between 1 and 10080 minutes.
error.no_members: Select at least one person or tracker, or connect a tracker account directly.
error.invalid_auth: Life360 did not accept these credentials.
error.different_account: Use the same Life360 account to keep your selected trackers. To switch accounts, remove this HomeCircle setup and set up a new household.
error.same_account_confirmation_required: HomeCircle could not verify the old account. Confirm that the new sign-in is for the same account before keeping these trackers.
error.rate_limited: Life360 is temporarily limiting sign-in. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not contact Life360. Try again later.
error.unexpected_response: Life360 returned an unexpected response. Check HomeCircle diagnostics if this continues.
error.invalid_tracker_source: A directly selected person or pet must use that tracker as the source.
error.direct_trackers_selected: Before disconnecting, replace HomeCircle-owned trackers selected here or linked to a selected Home Assistant Person.
error.tracker_already_in_person: This tracker is already linked to a selected Home Assistant Person. Keep that Person or choose the tracker as a separate member, not both.

abort.already_configured: HomeCircle is already configured. Use Options to edit the household.
abort.already_in_progress: HomeCircle setup is already in progress.
abort.provider_reauth_unavailable: This tracker connection cannot be reconnected here. Open HomeCircle Options to review the account.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HomeCircle household is supported. Use Options to edit it.

missing_entities.title: HomeCircle selections need attention
missing_entities.description: {count} selected entities are missing or disabled. Sources may still be starting. If they do not return, open HomeCircle Options to remove or replace them. Renamed entities must be selected again. Saved selections are retained; missing sources are not treated as Away.

life360_auth_failed.title: HomeCircle Life360 sign-in needs attention
life360_auth_failed.description: The direct Life360 connection is no longer authorized. Its trackers may be unavailable. Check the account authorization and reconnect HomeCircle; existing Home Assistant sources remain available.
